items.prompt:
A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic for a Chinese academic case-study report. Horizontal left-to-right layout with FOUR VERTICAL COLUMNS placed side by side across the full width of a wide canvas. Pure white background.

Column 1 (leftmost): a deep-green rounded header pill with white Chinese text "战略引领"; below it three light-mint rounded cards stacked vertically, each with a small flat green line icon and Chinese label: "全产业链深耕", "价值导向转换", "组织模式创新".
Column 2: deep-green header pill "机制嵌入"; three stacked light-mint cards: "准入赋能", "过程管控", "收益保障".
Column 3: deep-green header pill "田野运行"; three stacked light-mint cards: "备耕统一调度", "生长技术护航", "采收分级定价".
Column 4 (rightmost): deep-green header pill "共富成效"; three stacked light-mint cards: "农户增收", "产业升级", "能力跃迁".

A thick green right-pointing arrow sits between column 1 and 2, between column 2 and 3, and between column 3 and 4. Along the bottom of the whole figure a long curved green arrow runs from right back to left, labeled in Chinese "效应反馈与战略迭代".

Style: flat vector infographic, clean pure white background, thin uniform 2px stroke weight, rounded corners. Strict palette: deep forest green #1E5B3A for header pills with white text, medium green #4E8C63 for arrows and icons, very light mint #EAF4EE for card fills, dark grey #333333 for card text. Simple flat line-art icons only. All labels in Simplified Chinese, crisp correctly-formed characters, clean sans-serif. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, generous whitespace, precise grid alignment.
Strictly avoid: no photorealism, no 3D bevel, no drop shadows, no lens flare, no stock-photo people, no watermark, no signature, no English text, no decorative clutter, no gibberish characters.

A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic for a Chinese academic report, three vertical panels arranged left to right across a wide canvas, connected by two thick green right-pointing arrows. Pure white background.

Left panel: a deep-green rounded header pill with white Chinese text "农户三重要素壁垒"; below it three light-mint cards each with a flat green line icon and Chinese label: "无地可种", "无钱买棒", "无技可用".
Middle panel: a deep-green rounded header pill with white Chinese text "企业前置性资源让渡"; below it three light-mint cards with icons and Chinese labels: "土地无偿使用", "菌棒冷库共享", "培训学校赋能".
Right panel: a deep-green rounded header pill with white Chinese text "要素壁垒破解结果"; below it three light-mint cards with icons and Chinese labels: "零门槛进入产业", "沉没成本内部化", "持证上岗产业工人".

The two large green arrows between panels are labeled in Chinese above them: the first "资源下沉", the second "能力生成". A slim deep-green banner strip runs across the bottom of the figure with white Chinese text "准入赋能：把参与现代农业的门票先递到农户手中".

Style: flat vector infographic, clean pure white background, thin uniform 2px stroke weight, rounded corners. Strict palette: deep forest green #1E5B3A, medium green #4E8C63, very light mint #EAF4EE fills, dark grey #333333 text. Simple flat line-art icons only. All labels in Simplified Chinese, crisp correctly-formed characters, clean sans-serif. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, generous whitespace, precise alignment.
Strictly avoid: no photorealism, no 3D bevel, no drop shadows, no stock-photo people, no watermark, no signature, no English text, no decorative clutter, no gibberish characters.

A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic for a Chinese academic report. Pure white background. A central deep-green circle in the middle of the canvas containing white Chinese text on two lines "天和联农带农" and "实践体系". Three thick green arrows radiate from this circle: one to the left, one to the upper right, one to the lower right, each ending at a large light-mint rounded card.

Left card: deep-green title bar with white Chinese text "系统性", inside it three short Chinese bullet lines each preceded by a small green check icon: "战略—机制—运行—成效四层贯通", "准入·过程·收益三位一体", "制度化载体全环节覆盖".
Upper-right card: deep-green title bar with white Chinese text "先进性", inside three Chinese bullet lines with green check icons: "要素无偿让渡领先行业", "保底加二次返利复合分配", "签约续约率百分之百".
Lower-right card: deep-green title bar with white Chinese text "示范性", inside three Chinese bullet lines with green check icons: "带动农户一万五千余户", "区域品牌价值全国居首", "路径可复制可推广".

Style: flat vector infographic, clean pure white background, thin uniform 2px stroke weight, rounded corners. Strict palette: deep forest green #1E5B3A, medium green #4E8C63 arrows and icons, very light mint #EAF4EE card fills, dark grey #333333 body text. Simple flat line-art icons only. All labels in Simplified Chinese, crisp correctly-formed characters, clean sans-serif. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, balanced radial layout, generous whitespace.
Strictly avoid: no photorealism, no 3D bevel, no drop shadows, no stock-photo people, no watermark, no signature, no English text, no decorative clutter, no gibberish characters.

A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic for a Chinese academic report showing a three-circle Venn diagram of overlapping theory domains, on a pure white background.

Three large translucent circles overlap in the centre. The upper-left circle is outlined in deep green with a light mint fill and carries a deep-green label pill above it with white Chinese text "价值共创理论（DART模型）"; inside that circle three short Chinese lines: "对话", "获取", "风险评估与透明". The upper-right circle is outlined in medium green with a light mint fill, label pill with white Chinese text "利益联结机制理论"; inside three Chinese lines: "契约联结", "要素联结", "股份联结". The bottom circle is outlined in olive green with a light mint fill, label pill with white Chinese text "企业社会责任理论"; inside three Chinese lines: "经济与法律责任", "伦理责任", "慈善与共享责任".

The central overlapping area is a solid deep-green rounded shape with white Chinese text on two lines: "天和农业" and "三重利益联结共富实践". Around the outside, three small light-mint caption boxes with thin green leader lines point to the three pairwise overlaps, labeled in Chinese: "共创赋能", "共担共享", "责任内嵌".

Style: flat vector infographic, clean pure white background, thin uniform 2px stroke weight. Strict palette: deep forest green #1E5B3A, medium green #4E8C63, olive green #6B8F5A, very light mint #EAF4EE fills, dark grey #333333 text. All labels in Simplified Chinese, crisp correctly-formed characters, clean sans-serif. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, generous whitespace, symmetrical balance.
Strictly avoid: no photorealism, no 3D bevel, no drop shadows, no stock-photo people, no watermark, no signature, no English text except the word DART, no decorative clutter, no gibberish characters.

A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic for a Chinese academic report. Pure white background. On the LEFT HALF of the canvas a four-tier flat pyramid built from four stacked horizontal trapezoid bands, widest at the bottom, drawn in flat green tones that get darker toward the top. From bottom to top the bands carry centred white Chinese labels: bottom band "经济责任", second band "法律责任", third band "伦理责任", top band "慈善责任".

On the RIGHT HALF, four light-mint rounded annotation cards are stacked vertically and aligned with the pyramid bands, each linked to its band by a thin green leader line. From bottom to top the cards carry a small green line icon and Chinese text: bottom card "稳定经营与全产业链增值：出口四十余国、G20食材总仓", second card "合规履约与质量安全：ISO22000、FSSC、有机认证、百分之百履约", third card "利益让渡与风险共担：土地菌棒冷库无偿供给、保底收购、二次返利", top card "公益反哺与区域共富：疫情滞销收储四百余吨、香菇博物馆与灵芝文化园".

A slim deep-green banner strip across the bottom of the figure holds white Chinese text "责任履行由被动合规走向主动共创".

Style: flat vector infographic, clean pure white background, thin uniform 2px stroke weight, rounded corners on cards. Strict palette: deep forest green #1E5B3A for the top pyramid band, medium greens #2F6F49 and #4E8C63 for middle bands, pale green #8FB89A for the bottom band, very light mint #EAF4EE for cards, dark grey #333333 for card text. Simple flat line-art icons only. All labels in Simplified Chinese, crisp correctly-formed characters, clean sans-serif. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, generous whitespace.
Strictly avoid: no photorealism, no 3D bevel, no drop shadows, no stock-photo people, no watermark, no signature, no English text except ISO22000 FSSC and G20, no decorative clutter, no gibberish characters.

A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic for a Chinese academic report showing a closed circular feedback loop, on a pure white background.

Four large light-mint rounded cards are placed at the four corners of a wide ring layout: upper-left, upper-right, lower-right, lower-left. Thick green curved arrows connect them clockwise in a continuous closed loop: upper-left to upper-right to lower-right to lower-left and back up to upper-left.

Upper-left card: deep-green title bar with white Chinese text "获取·奠基"; inside two short Chinese lines "土地菌棒冷库技术打包让渡" and "农户获得参与资格".
Upper-right card: deep-green title bar with white Chinese text "对话·润滑"; inside two Chinese lines "植保员驻点与代表制协商" and "指令执行转为协商调适".
Lower-right card: deep-green title bar with white Chinese text "风险·护航"; inside two Chinese lines "保底收购与技术兜底" and "末梢承担转为有限承担".
Lower-left card: deep-green title bar with white Chinese text "透明·固本"; inside two Chinese lines "价格公开与二次返利公示" and "透明生信任信任固关系".

Each connecting arrow carries a small Chinese label on it: between upper-left and upper-right "资源赋予对话资格"; between upper-right and lower-right "对话识别风险"; between lower-right and lower-left "分担要求公开"; between lower-left and upper-left "信任反哺投入".

In the exact centre of the ring, a deep-green circle with white Chinese text on two lines: "价值共创" and "正反馈闭环".

Style: flat vector infographic, clean pure white background, thin uniform 2px stroke weight, rounded corners. Strict palette: deep forest green #1E5B3A, medium green #4E8C63 for arrows, very light mint #EAF4EE for card fills, dark grey #333333 for body text. All labels in Simplified Chinese, crisp correctly-formed characters, clean sans-serif. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, symmetrical, generous whitespace.
Strictly avoid: no photorealism, no 3D bevel, no drop shadows, no stock-photo people, no watermark, no signature, no English text, no decorative clutter, no gibberish characters.

A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic roadmap for a Chinese academic report, laid out as a horizontal timeline running left to right across a wide canvas. Pure white background.

A thick horizontal green baseline arrow runs across the middle of the canvas from left to right, ending in an arrowhead. Four numbered deep-green circular milestone markers sit on the line, labeled 01, 02, 03, 04 in white.

Above each marker is a deep-green rounded title pill with white Chinese text: above marker 01 "资源让渡启动期", above 02 "订单联结稳定期", above 03 "股份合作深化期", above 04 "内生共富成熟期".
Below each marker is a light-mint rounded card containing two short Chinese lines. Below 01: "无偿供给土地设施菌棒" and "破解农户进入壁垒". Below 02: "保底收购与全程技术服务" and "锁定长期契约关系". Below 03: "要素入股与二次返利分配" and "共享全链条增值收益". Below 04: "本土技术人才自我循环" and "产业带动区域共同富裕".

At the far left edge, a vertical deep-green side tab with white Chinese text reading "可推广实施路径". Along the very bottom, a slim light-mint strip with dark grey Chinese text "适配条件：山区资源禀赋集中、龙头企业全链掌控力、地方制度支持、在地社会资本".

Style: flat vector infographic, clean pure white background, thin uniform 2px stroke weight, rounded corners. Strict palette: deep forest green #1E5B3A, medium green #4E8C63, very light mint #EAF4EE, dark grey #333333. Simple flat line-art icons only where helpful. All labels in Simplified Chinese, crisp correctly-formed characters, clean sans-serif. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, generous whitespace, precise alignment.
Strictly avoid: no photorealism, no 3D bevel, no drop shadows, no stock-photo people, no watermark, no signature, no English text except the numerals 01 02 03 04, no decorative clutter, no gibberish characters.
